title: rosa canina var. sylvularum
intro: Rosa canina var. sylvularum, commonly known as the wild dog rose, is a deciduous shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, particularly in its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. sylvularum include its potential to soothe digestive issues, improve circulation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
